grammar: 使用第三人稱單數的現在簡單式詢問與回答職業，以及使用 want to be… 表達未來願望。
intro_zh: 這一課我們會認識不同的職業，學會用 What does he/she do? 詢問別人的工作，並練習說出自己想成為什麼樣的人，例如老師、醫生或消防員。
can_do: 能用第三人稱單數說出他/她的職業
能用 want to be… 說出自己未來想從事的工作
能閱讀簡短對話並找出關鍵職業單字

sentences.en: In our town, Mr. Lin is a fisherman who goes out to sea every morning.
sentences.zh: 在我們的鎮子裡，林先生是個漁夫，每天早上都出海捕魚。

sentences.en: Ms. Chen works as a writer and writes stories for children.
sentences.zh: 陳小姐是作家，她寫兒童故事。

sentences.en: At the hospital, Nurse Lee takes care of patients with kindness.
sentences.zh: 在醫院裡，李護士用愛心照顧病人。

sentences.en: Officer Wang is a police man who keeps the streets safe.
sentences.zh: 王警官是警察，負責維持街道安全。

sentences.en: The boss of the factory, Mr. Huang, likes to hear new ideas from his workers and says everyone should love their own job.
sentences.zh: 工廠老闆黃先生喜歡聽工人們的新點子，並說每個人應該熱愛自己的工作。

sentences.en: Sometimes the king and queen visit the town to see the local business.
sentences.zh: 國王和皇后偶爾會來鎮子參觀當地的商業。

sentences.en: A businessman named Mr. Li shared his experience at the meeting.
sentences.zh: 一位名叫李先生的商人在會議上分享了他的經驗。

sentences.en: He said that every case is different and every chance to learn matters.
sentences.zh: 他說每個個案都不同，每一次學習的機會都很重要。

sentences.en: After work, the fireman practices his plan to stay ready for emergencies.
sentences.zh: 下班後，消防員會練習他的計畫，以便隨時應對緊急狀況。

grammar_points.title_zh: ① What does he/she do? – 第三人稱單數現在簡單式詢問職業
grammar_points.explain_zh: 用來問別人現在的職業，答案通常是 He/She is a … 或 He/She works as a … 。動詞 do 在第三人稱單數變成 does，後面接動詞原形。
table: He works as a police man.

grammar_points.title_zh: ② want to be … – 表達未來願望
grammar_points.explain_zh: 用 want to be + 職業名詞，表示將來想成為某種職業。主語可以是 I, you, he, she, we, they。

examples.en: I want to be a businessman when I grow up.
She wants to be a queen someday.
They want to be firemen to help people.
examples.zh: 他們想當消防員來幫助人們。

examples.en: He wants to be a writer and write stories.

lines.en: He is a police man. He keeps the town safe.
lines.zh: 他是警察，負責保護鎮上的安全。

lines.en: What do you want to be when you grow up?
I want to be a fireman. I want to help people in danger.
lines.zh: 我想當消防員，幫助有危險的人。

lines.en: That’s a great job! I want to be a nurse and take care of sick people.
lines.zh: 這是很棒的工作！我想當護士，照顧生病的人。

sentences.en: What does she do? She is a writer.
sentences.zh: 她的職業是什麼？她是作家。

sentences.en: What does he do? He works as a businessman.
sentences.zh: 他的職業是什麼？他是商人。

sentences.en: She wants to be a queen one day.
He wants to be a fireman to save lives.
sentences.zh: 他想當消防員來救生命。

sentences.en: What does your mother do? She is a nurse.
sentences.zh: 你媽媽的職業是什麼？她是護士。

sentences.en: They want to be teachers and share knowledge.
sentences.zh: 他們想當老師，分享知識。

sentences.en: What does the king do? He rules the country.
sentences.zh: 國王的職業是什麼？他統治國家。

sentences.en: I want to be a writer and write interesting stories.
sentences.zh: 我想當作家，寫有趣的故事。

mcq.q: 「漁夫」的英文是什麼？
「作家」的英文是什麼？
「護士」的英文是什麼？
「警察」的英文是什麼？
「老闆」的英文是什麼？
「國王」的英文是什麼？
「消防員」的英文是什麼？
「商人」的英文是什麼？
「工作」的英文是什麼？
「想法」的英文是什麼？
______ she a writer?
He ______ want to be a fireman.
What ______ he want to be?
She ______ a nurse.
They ______ businessmen.
______ you want to be a king?
______ she want to be a queen?
He has a ______ to start his own business.
She has a ______ as a fisherman.
The meeting is for an ______.
Tom likes to help people and wants to work in a hospital. What does he want to be?
opts: He wants to be a nurse.
He wants to be a writer.
He wants to be a fisherman.
He wants to be a king.
mcq.ans: He wants to be a nurse.

mcq.q: Lily loves stories and writes books every day. What does she want to be?
opts: She wants to be a boss.
She wants to be a writer.
She wants to be a queen.
She wants to be a fireman.
mcq.ans: She wants to be a writer.

mcq.q: Mr. Chen enjoys catching fish at sea. What is his job?
Ms. Lin works in an office and manages a company. What is her job?
The class is planning a project and they need to talk about it. What is the meeting for?
opts: The meeting is for a plan.
The meeting is for a chance.
The meeting is for a case.
The meeting is for a matter.
mcq.ans: The meeting is for a plan.

mcq.q: Sarah wants to start her own store someday. What does she have?
John worked on a fishing boat last summer. What does he have?
opts: He has experience as a fisherman.
He has experience as a writer.
He has experience as a nurse.
He has experience as a king.
mcq.ans: He has experience as a fisherman.

mcq.q: The teacher asks: "Do you want to be a king?" Tom answers: "Yes, I do." What is the correct question form?
opts: Do you want to be a king?
Does you want to be a king?
Is you want to be a king?
Are you want to be a king?
mcq.ans: Do you want to be a king?

mcq.q: Lisa dreams of living in a palace. What does she want to be?
opts: She wants to be a queen.
She wants to be a boss.
She wants to be a writer.
She wants to be a fireman.
mcq.ans: She wants to be a queen.

mcq.q: The manager holds a gathering to discuss sales. What is it?

fill.q: My father is a ____. He works in a hospital.（我父親是護士。他在醫院工作。）
She ____ to be a writer when she grows up.（她長大後想當作家。）
The ____ helps people. He puts out fires.（消防員幫助人們。他滅火。）
Does he want to be a ____? Yes, he does.（他想當警察嗎？是的。）
My uncle is a ____. He catches fish every day.（我叔叔是漁夫。他每天捕魚。）
The ____ makes decisions in the company.（老闆在公司裡做決定。）
A ____ owns a business and makes money.（商人擁有生意並賺錢。）
The ____ lives in a palace and rules the country.（國王住在宮殿裡並統治國家。）
She has a good ____ for a new project.（她對新計畫有好想法。）
This is an important ____ for you. You should take it.（這對你是個重要的機會。你應該把握它。）

translate.ans: She wants to be a nurse.
I want to be a fireman.

unscramble.q: be / writer / a / . / She / to / wants
unscramble.ans: She wants to be a writer.

unscramble.q: I / want / to / a / be / . / fireman
unscramble.ans: I want to be a fireman.
